title: PV Power Plant Startup & Testing Manager
description:
**PV Power Plant Startup \& Testing Manager**
=============================================

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------


Help accelerate clean energy by bringing utility\-scale solar assets online—safely, reliably, and on schedule. As our client’s commissioning partner, you’ll ensure every inverter, tracker, substation, and SCADA point performs as designed, and that each site clears PPA, GIA, and ISO requirements with confidence.

**Where you’ll work**
---------------------

* **Location:** Remote across the U.S.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Plan and prepare sites for PPA, GIA, and ISO testing; steer startup and commissioning activities as the Owner’s representative.
* Coordinate test energy forecasts and AVR/AGC notifications with customers, the control center, and external parties.
* Partner with IT \& SCADA teams on functional checks and point\-to\-point validation.
* Develop the commissioning schedule tied to mechanical completion with the SCADA Integrator and Execution Commissioning Project Manager.
* Validate SCADA HMI functionality and data accuracy with the SCADA Integrator and Commissioning Manager.
* Support CEWIS Critical Point Checkout with ROCC alarm checks/PGD.
* Identify and resolve performance deficiencies using data\-driven reviews.
* Manage and report on commissioning performed by contractors and vendors at the project site; provide clear status reporting.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Engineering degree or equivalent experience.
* At least 5 years of experience with utility solar power systems.

* Academic or professional work centered on utility PV.
